CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot state
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. Full colony gamestate snapshot as JSON (day, colonists, threat, food, medicine, weather, storyteller).

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot pawns
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON list of free colonists (name, skills, health, mood, job).

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot pawn check
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON hediffs with bleeding/tended/scar/missing flags and advice (rest vs healer serum). Usage: !botpawncheck [name]. Empty = bot's pawn.

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot threats
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON live threat check: hostile faction members (not prisoners/slaves), manhunter animals, scaria animals (deduped). Use to see if a raid or pack is still active.

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot map
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON map info (name, biome, temperature, weather, season).

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot wealth
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON wealth breakdown (total, items, buildings, pawns) and threat points.

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot resources
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON stockpile counts (meals, medicine, materials, components).

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot gear
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON full loadout of the bot's assigned pawn (equipment, sidearms, all inventory, apparel). Not for viewers.

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot faction
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON faction details (name, common race, relation, vanilla type, Ideology major memes if DLC). Usage: !botfaction [name]. Empty = list.

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot owned
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. JSON list of RICS-owned weapons and apparel for the assigned pawn (equipped, worn, inventory, chests, map, caravan). Includes quality and condition (hpPct). Not !mypawn owned.

CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.label: bot disown
CAP_ChatInteractive.ChatCommandDef.commandDescription: AI bot only. Unclaim one RICS-owned item. Usage: !botdisown <thingId|label>. Prefer thingId from !botowned. JSON result with quality and condition of the cleared item.
